description: Black-and-white (blue-toned) photograph of a bearded man in tactical gear — plate carrier with rifle magazines, headset, cap, sunglasses, and a Punisher-skull patch — holding a gloved palm toward the camera in front of razor wire. The names of the four Americans killed in the 2012 Benghazi attack (Stevens, Woods, Doherty, Smith) are written on the glove fingers, with 'WE WONT FORGET #KILLARY' on the palm, a slogan blaming Hillary Clinton for the deaths. Screenshot borders (black bars) indicate the image was captured from a phone.
text: STEVENS. WOODS. DOHERTY. SMITH. WE WONT FORGET. #KILLARY.
flags: Armed man is an unidentified private individual — not named
#Killary slogan implies Hillary Clinton culpability for Benghazi deaths — a claim, not a finding

description: Screenshot of a Politico article (Congress section) by Andrew Desiderio, May 14 2020, headlined 'Graham shoots down Trump's call for Obama testimony on Russia probe origins'. Photo shows Sen. Lindsey Graham at a Senate hearing dais removing a face mask, credited to Caroline Brehman/CQ Roll Call/Pool via AP. The lede reports Graham rebuffed President Trump's pleas for the Judiciary Committee to call former President Obama to testify about the origins of the Russia investigation and the FBI's handling of the Michael Flynn case.
text: CONGRESS. Graham shoots down Trump's call for Obama testimony on Russia probe origins. In recent days, President Donald Trump has mounted an aggressive campaign against his predecessor. Sen. Lindsey Graham. | Caroline Brehman/CQ Roll Call/Pool via AP. By ANDREW DESIDERIO. 05/14/2020 12:02 PM EDT. Updated: 05/14/2020 12:37 PM EDT. Sen. Lindsey Graham on Thursday brushed back President Donald Trump's pleas for the Judiciary Committee chairman to haul in former President Barack Obama for testimony about the origins of the Russia investigation and the FBI's handling of the investigation into Michael Flynn.

description: Video-frame style photograph of a White House Rose Garden press event during the coronavirus pandemic, consistent with the May 15 2020 Operation Warp Speed vaccine announcement. A U.S. Army four-star general in green service uniform, consistent with Gen. Gustavo Perna, speaks at a podium bearing the Presidential seal before a large American flag. President Donald Trump stands to the left unmasked; behind and beside him are masked officials consistent with NIH Director Francis Collins and Dr. Deborah Birx, with Dr. Anthony Fauci masked at right.
text: SEAL OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES.
flags: General at podium identified from uniform and context as Gustavo Perna — probable, not certain
Masked officials (Collins, Birx) identified with less certainty due to face coverings
